item.tib: thar glud mdos kyi mngon rtogs bskyed rim
item.coloph: ces mdos kyi bskyed rim snang gsal sgron ma 'di/ khyad par thar glud mdos la dgos ched che ba'i phyir/ rgyas bsdu gang yang ma byas 'bring tsam 'di/ mkhas pa du mas gzigs na snang gsal sgron/ go rtogs can la dgos pa e mtshar/ rmongs pa can la dgos ched che phyir bsgrigs/ mun khrod rdzas blug kha dog 'byed dka' bas/ rgyud 'grel las bstan nas bdag gis bkod/ lhag chad sdeb nyes ma tshangs gyur srid na/ zhi khro'i lha tshogs rnams la mthol lo bshags/ dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs la bzod par gsol/ rtsa ba'i bla ma'i thugs kyis ye ma khrel/ bon skyongs srung mas ko lang ma mdzad cig klag gtad dgon gyi dbus dkyil/ gtsug lag khang gi yang thog rgung zla tha chung mchu nya'i gza' skar tshes bzang la/ gshen gyi drang srong nam mkha' rgyal mtshan gyi (gyis) sbyar ba'o//
